prompt:
Locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. Behind the glass at the wooden counter, the cashier in the blonde bob wig and navy balaclava with the white ring and the red triangle over his left eye (right of frame) faces the camera. He pauses with his black-gloved hands on the POSITION CLOSED sign, then with one fingertip nudges it the last few centimetres across the ledge, small and precise. He leans back and rests his hands in his lap, perfectly still, still facing the camera. A beat later, on the right of frame, the tall black server cabinet with its small screen reading DISCOUNT APPLIED winds down: its fans slow to a lazy turn, its lights dim a little. It then reverses slowly on its castors, a heavy, smooth backward roll, staying rigid and upright, and drifts out of frame to the right. The counter, the carved wooden pillar and the POWER sign above stay exactly as they are; the small sign on the ledge reads POSITION CLOSED throughout and the screen reads DISCOUNT APPLIED while it is in view. Same light throughout.
Natural documentary realism, soft overhead light.
Thanks.
